typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial-like) throughout. Title is very large (~54pt) bold red. Body text is bold at roughly 16-20pt. Italic styling used for 'Correctly Classified', 'All Samples', and 'Accuracy of ALL Classes'. Color-coding carries meaning: red for positive-class/error items and conclusions, green for correct/negative-class items, blue for questions and key class words. Table headers 'Predicted as'/'Actual' in red; matrix cell values in black bold. No numbered bullets; boxes are used instead of bullet lists.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built (all boxes, tables, and diagram visible). The 'N' column header in the numeric confusion matrix shows a hand-drawn strikethrough/pen annotation, likely made live during the video, not a build state.
